why: The main Hartshorne conjecture on complete intersections (n >= 2c+1 implies complete intersection) remains open per multiple sources, but a June 2025 arXiv paper (2405.04002) classifies quadratic varieties in the adjacent boundary case n=2c-1, extending prior classification of the extremal case n=2c; unclear whether this counts as progress on the stated conjecture's own boundary case or is a separate classification problem near it.
queries: Hartshorne's conjectures algebraic geometry Wikipedia unsolved problems

found.title: Classification of quadratic varieties with n = 2c - 1 (extending Hartshorne conjecture boundary case work)
found.note: arXiv preprint (v3, June 2025) classifying quadratic varieties in the case n=2c-1, adjacent to Hartshorne's conjectured range n>=2c+1; not read.
